title: LoCoMo Conversational Memory Evaluation Slice
description: Benchmark evaluation dataset for evaluating long-term conversational memory strategies in LLM agents. Derived from the LoCoMo benchmark (Maharana et al., ACL 2024). Contains 12 longitudinal dialogue sessions (48 total turns) and 10 fact-probe evaluation queries testing factual retention, temporal reasoning, user preferences, and knowledge updates across sessions.
